en: Hmhm... Hello, and welcome.{PAGE}Today, I have a little diversion{SAUT}prepared for you.{PAGE}That said, it's nothing too difficult.{SAUT}The rules are quite simple.{PAGE}Up ahead, you will see two signs.{SAUT}Each has a question printed on{SAUT}them.{PAGE}Please answer the questions, then{SAUT}proceed in accordance with your{SAUT}answers.{PAGE}*chuckle* I wonder what you will{SAUT}think, once you see where your{SAUT}answers will lead you?
Hm. I didn't sense any hostility from{SAUT}them... It seemed like they were{SAUT}just explaining the rules.
So all we have to do is answer{SAUT}questions on signs? We'll have to{SAUT}see the questions first...
All right, first order of business is to{SAUT}find those signs. Let's go, Joker.
